newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin needs 10-15 days to shake off illness-Tass.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin needs 10-15 days to shake off illness-Tass.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin is still "somewhat weak" after his bout of pneumonia and he needs at least 10 or 15 more days to recover, Itar-Tass news agency quoted heart surgeon Renat Akchurin as saying.
Akchurin, who carried out a multiple bypass operation on the president last November, said the pneumonia posed no risk for Yeltsin's heart.
Akchurin said Yeltsin's recovery from pneumonia was going "as it should" and the president was gradually getting better and taking more walks.

"But at the same time Boris Yeltsin is 'somewhat weakened' and he needs to restore his strength and put on some weight," Tass said. "Pneumonia is not a joke and there should be no haste in the recovery process," Tass quoted Akchurin as saying.
Yeltsin has looked stiff in television appearances since he fell ill with pneumonia last month and he has clearly lost a great deal of weight.
He has had several meetings with ministers and aides in a country residence outside Moscow and -- occasionally -- in the Kremlin.
